FN-DGVKMHN-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 63
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/27/2026
Senate Bill 63 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Department of Insurance to adopt rules regarding health insurers' use of artificial intelligence in
utilization review. However, any increased obligations could be offset partially by
administrative fines, not to exceed $5,000, imposed for violations pursuant to the provisions of
this bill.
